rule: Each call in a multi-line method chain is reported on the line of its own method name, not the chain's first line. ... **Parameterless members are typed receivers (decision A)**: a receiver that is a call of a parameterless method ... with a declared type ... names that type ... Call on a computed receiver (call result, ...): `.member`
notes: call_type convention (SPEC names the six call_types but does not define direct vs method): a call with no written receiver is direct; a call with a written receiver (obj., this., super., a type name) is method; new/super(...)/this(...) are constructor. start() and filter() are parameterless with declared return type Pipeline, so each next link is typed Pipeline (Decisions 2026-11-09). limit(int) has a parameter, so the parameterless rule does not apply: `.done()` on `limit(3)`'s result is a computed receiver, `.done`, low (C4: still emitted as a low guess). Every edge is on the line of its own method name.
